rule: prompts/ holds exactly the prompt files a live loader in src/ names. A superseded prompt file is never edited and never deleted: it is moved here, and listed below with the reason its bytes are still the preimage of something. tests/test_architecture.py enforces both halves, so a file in neither state fails make check rather than sitting unexplained.
why_not_deleted: Every ExtractionRun row records prompt_version and prompt_sha256 (src/corridor/storage_baseline.py). Those rows live in databases this repository cannot read, so a released run may name a prompt whose only preimage is the file it was read from. minutes_v3.md shows the case is real and not hypothetical, and matrix_tiered_v2/v3 show what is lost without this rule: the same retained receipt names them, no file in the repository has their bytes, and that prompt is now unrecoverable.

basis_values.receipt: a retained artifact in this repository names this prompt version
basis_values.stored-run-digest: no artifact in this repository names it; retained because a stored ExtractionRun outside the repository still may

minutes_v3.md.note: extraction_run_receipts[1] of that receipt is an exported ExtractionRun (run_id 206507) recording prompt_version minutes_v3 and no prompt_sha256, so these bytes are the only preimage of the prompt that run read.
